verdict.rationale: The evidence presents Crawl4AI as an open-source, self-hosted library and CLI (Docker/FastAPI deployment, no forced API keys) rather than a vendor-operated hosted service. A public uptime status page with incident postmortems is a hosted-service axis, so it does not apply to software the user runs on their own infrastructure. Nothing in the pack shows a managed Crawl4AI service whose uptime would be tracked.
